seoDescription: Read Ojobo Agbo Eje's published research on the State AI Readiness Index and explainable AI in healthcare, with links to Rutgers and the peer-reviewed journal Algorithms.
text_003: My published research examines AI readiness in public institutions and explainable AI in healthcare. The question behind both is practical: what conditions make adoption responsible, understandable, and useful?
image_001_alt: Original editorial image of a researcher examining maps and charts
text_007: How governance, data, workforce capability, and infrastructure shape AI readiness.
text_010: How transparent AI can support more responsible decisions in high-stakes environments.
text_013: How analysis and visualization can make structural conditions legible.
text_016: How people, process, technology, and culture interact in transformation.
text_021: Evidence matters when it is accessible, understandable, and connected to decisions.
text_023: Governance, data quality, capability, and context shape outcomes as much as the model does.
text_026: CHEDVI brings complex patterns into an interface people can explore.
